Harnesses on the Galaxy S26 (serial RFGL80R6A6H, LiteRT 2.2.0, Android 16): (1) the d1_omni lane's debug gate app in generic mode (rows files from make_rows.py name the signature and its inputs as little-endian files; one process per leg; a 'generic' leg runs every fixture row once and is the parity leg, a 'generic_timing' leg runs 3 warm-up calls then 20 timed calls of write inputs + run + read outputs on fixture row 0 on the rested phone: thermal status 0, no CPU cap, GPU idle at 422 MHz before each leg, round p2 19:55-20:00 JST, rounds p3 / p4 20:31-20:38 JST); (2) the Kev lane's C-API runner for the HTP (LiteRT 2.2.0 + the Qualcomm compiler plugin / dispatch libraries, JIT with a cold cache per leg, --accel npu+cpu, BURST; 5 warm-ups then 20 rounds; round n1 20:10-20:31 JST). Parity reference for every S26 row = the same graph on the Mac (ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 XNNPACK, fp32) on the lane fixtures (readme1 / own1 for the acoustic graphs, the decoder windows of all six texts for the decoder); the lane bar is corr >= 0.999 and SNR >= 30 dB on every row and output. Ship assignment per the lane (SPEED_LADDER.md row 5f, FINDINGS.md section 5 round n1), one 3.5 s sentence (readme1: 60 letters, 88 frames = text L64 + align L64/T96 + 4 x step T96 + decoder P48 + P120): text + align on the CPU, the four steps on the HTP, the decoder on the GPU at fp16 = 0.7 + 0.2 + 4 x 1.56 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 52.5 ms (RTF 0.015, first audio 21.7 ms); without the Qualcomm NPU libraries (acoustic graphs on the CPU, decoder on the GPU fp16) 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 14.6 + 31.0 = 56.5 ms (RTF 0.016, first audio 25.5 ms); everything on the GPU fp32 (split) 1.4 + 0.7 + 12.8 + 22.2 + 54.9 = 92.0 ms (RTF 0.026); everything on the CPU 4 threads 0.7 + 0.2 + 10.0 + 39.1 + 98.8 = 148.8 ms (RTF 0.042, first audio 50 ms) — the per-graph terms are the round p2 rested medians (device/p2/P2_*.json) and the n1 HTP step median; the decoder terms come from the fp32 single-bucket files (the shipped fp16-weight decoder gives the same GPU fp16 figures: 14.6 / 30.5 ms, rounds p3). This file: the HiFi-GAN decoder (z [1,64,P] + 7 host-built float masks m0..m6 [1,1,len_i] -> audio f32 [1,P*1920] at 48 kHz; signatures ema_decoder_P48 (1.9 s, the first window of a piece) and ema_decoder_P120 (4.8 s); 970 nodes per signature = the 854 nodes of the fp32 graph + 116 DEQUANTIZE).
